name: category-entry-check
description: Compare App Store categories before you build: what the #10, #25 and #50 apps are estimated to make, how concentrated the top is, how many young apps chart, review bases, and paid-ad, organic and search pressure. One PeekPanda market leaderboard read per category; Markdown/CSV/JSON and an optional Slack or Discord post.
author: Fekri Darkaoui
